workLog.summary: Read issue #3349 in full including all four comments. The issue is one I filed and already contains a falsified remedy of my own: a group-name coherence gate replayed over 14 revisions of dispatch_groups.json false-positives on healthy descriptive groups in 12 of them. The corrected remedy named in the discourse is an authorized-hook inventory.

Confirmed the defect live rather than from prose. The hook-state ledger records status created at 02:14 UTC today and the retrospective that run wrote is committed at 3d1f3b30d2, so invoke_auto_retrospective.py was still firing on this repo's own sessions after #3197 retired it. A clean-clone probe skipped with 'not the ai-agents project repo (consumer repo)', so live ledger evidence stands in for a fresh reproduction.

Measured the guard gap. Eight files carrying 103 tests read dispatch_groups.json and every one validates structure, wiring or counts. test_operational_skills_match_current_hook_registration_counts pinned '4 events, 5 groups', a figure both leaked hooks satisfied. No artifact recorded which hooks are authorized to run, so nothing could compare intent to registration.

Kept invoke_context_loader.py and deleted invoke_auto_retrospective.py rather than treating both #3349 hooks alike. The retrospective hook dirties the working tree at session end and emits decision: block to force another turn, measured net-negative by #3187. The context loader is read-only, fail-open, and automates the documented SESSION-PROTOCOL start gate for this repo's own sessions; its customer-facing copy was already purged under ADR-084. The keep is recorded in AUTHORIZED_HOOKS with that rationale, which satisfies acceptance criterion 2.

Deleted the 829-line hook, its test file, its CLAUDE.md and its directory; dropped stop-1-skill_learning from dispatch_groups.json and the whole Stop key from settings.json; renamed sessionstart-1-session_initialization_enforcer to sessionstart-1-context_loader now that the group holds one shim.

Added AUTHORIZED_HOOKS to test_dispatch_groups_parity.py, one entry per hook naming the ADR or issue that authorized it, plus test_every_dispatched_hook_is_authorized and its converse test_no_authorization_outlives_the_hook_it_authorizes. Adding a hook now requires stating its authorization in the same PR.

Replayed the new gate over history as its negative control. origin/main reports exactly invoke_auto_retrospective.py with zero false positives; 8318d1c3 adds invoke_test_auto_approval.py, correct because it was genuinely registered then; df34cd43 reports 18, the true size of the un-purged backlog. The falsified name-coherence gate was rejected on the same replay.

Rewrote test_stop_policy_is_local_only_after_vendored_hook_purge as test_no_stop_hook_is_registered_on_any_surface. The Stop path is gone rather than reduced, so absence across all four surfaces plus group-id and group-event absence is the assertion.

Corrected four skills, the retro command and CONTRIBUTING, which all described the hook in the present tense. Two CONTRIBUTING rows went rather than one: the PermissionRequest row named invoke_test_auto_approval.py, absent from disk since #3295. Registration counts in the two operational skills moved to 3 events / 4 groups.

Left ADR-008 untouched and flagged it instead. Its two implementation tables already carry three hooks deleted in #3184 and #3295 without amendment, so the staleness predates this change; an ADR edit also fires the adr-review gate for a historical record that is out of scope for #3349.

1960 passed, 1 skipped across tests/hooks, tests/build_scripts and tests/test_lefthook_integration.py. Regenerated the copilot skill mirrors with build_all.py and bumped both project-toolkit manifests to 0.6.115 after main advanced past the original 0.6.113 reservation, keeping 0.6.114 free for PR #3376 to land first.
